item.title: Billboard Hot Latin Songs Top 10 Countdown for June 27, 2026 | Billboard Latin
item.description:
[Upbeat music fades out, and the host begins speaking]
Host: Welcome back to our podcast, where we dive into the latest music charts. This week, we're looking at the Billboard Hot Latin Songs top 10. Let's see who's making moves.
[Short music transition]
Host: Starting from the bottom, we have "Coco" holding steady at number 10, followed by "De Lejitos" at number 9, and "Daño" at number 8. "Ayúdame" stays put at number 7, and "Voy a Llevarte Pa PR" takes the sixth spot.
[Short music transition]
Host: Now, let's talk about the top 5. Karol G's "Si Antes Te Hubiera Conocido" is at number 5, with "EoO" just ahead at number 4. "Nuevayol" is charging forward at number 3, and "Baile Inolvidable" holds firm at number 2.
[Short music transition]
Host: And at the top of the chart, Bad Bunny's "DTMF" continues its impressive reign for its 65th week. But can Karol G's "Si Antes Te Hubiera Conocido" make a jump to number 1? We'll be keeping an eye on it. Thanks for tuning in, and don't forget to subscribe for more music updates.
[Outro music starts playing]
